context: Tests whether an environment-caused authentication failure is translated into one rerun from the authenticated session while web remains disabled and failure does not trigger fallback.

checklist.name: Auth cause recognized
checklist.description: rerun-plan.md explains that the provider resolves authentication from the preserved environment and user configuration, so the rerun must come from the developer's authenticated session

checklist.name: Commit mode
checklist.description: The exact command uses slopguard review --mode commit --commit HEAD

checklist.name: Codex retained
checklist.description: The rerun keeps --engine codex and does not switch provider

checklist.name: Web-off stated
checklist.description: The plan explicitly states that web access remains disabled

checklist.name: Task contract retained
checklist.description: The rerun pipes the same authoritative task contract through standard input using --prompt-file -

checklist.name: Runtime boundary explained
checklist.description: The plan notes that the review preserves user provider state while the CLI still uses an empty provider workspace and frozen bundle

checklist.name: No repeated auth loop
checklist.description: If authentication fails again, the plan reports an operational blocker rather than retrying indefinitely

checklist.name: No fallback
checklist.description: The plan does not automatically switch to Claude or Cursor after another failure
